data.body: Plan review T4 advisory (non-blocking, impact 0.0) asked whether any caller depends on the exit code. Checked rather than assumed. The only caller is tasks.py line 131, the operator-invoked inv import-rebar-tickets. It goes through _run_scripted, which calls invoke's c.run with the default warn=False, so a non-zero exit raises UnexpectedExit and surfaces to the operator. No .github workflow references the script. The exit-code change therefore breaks no automation and makes the invoke task fail visibly on a partial import, which is the intent.
